text:
drew: Quick sync — proposing a short-term pin on runtime v4.0.0 for the APAC canary cohort. We're seeing rare kernel mismatches for quant-v4 that surface as transient decodes (garbled tokens) under long-seq loads. Need a quick ops decision.

mira: How many hosts are affected and is dedicated capacity impacted? Any customer tickets yet?

drew: 7 hosts in apac-canary; dedicated pools unaffected for now. No customer reports yet; found by internal longseq smoke. Impact: some responses contain garbled utf sequences leading to parse errors for downstream JSON consumers.

deploy-bot: Pin request: `/pin add runtime:v4.0.0 --scope=apac-canary --expires=3h --reason="kernel-quant-decode-glitch"` (PinID: pin-20250910-77). Applied to orchestrator.

sre-bot: Alert created: `apac-kernel-decode-pin-2111111111`. Telemetry hooks configured; auto-escalate if error rate > 0.8% for 10m.

yolanda: Can we repro locally? I'll run extended decode fuzz over quant-v4 on a couple affected images. Running: `./tools/decode_fuzz.sh --model quant-v4 --iters 500 --seed=42`.

drew: Proposed abort criteria: sustained parse-error rate > 0.5% OR consumer errors > 1 in 30m. Rollback command: `/pin remove pin-20250910-77` or `deploybot rollback --pin pin-20250910-77`. If rollback happens, page #incidents and SRE.

mira: I like adding a communication note for CS: "We're pausing a canary routing to investigate a decode regression; customers on dedicated or hosted public endpoints are not affected. We'll update in ~3h."

yolanda: Fuzz run half-done: 250/500, hit 2 decode anomalies but both reproducible locally; investigating commit at runtime kernels repo. Posting short dump to #eng-runtime-debug.

drew: Thanks. I'm drafting a release note entry and will keep pin for 3h unless we see worsening. Tagging @mira @yolanda for signoff to remove.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at T+2h30m: `/pin check pin-20250910-77 --telemetry apac-kernel-decode-pin-2111111111`.
